newsitem.title: USA: Biomatrix, Bayer in osteoarthritis pact.
newsitem.headline: Biomatrix, Bayer in osteoarthritis pact.

text.p: Biomatrix Inc said Tuesday it had signed an agreement for Bayer AG to market Biomatrix's Synvisc in Australia, New Zealand, Taiwan, Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and Israel.
Synvisc is Biomatrix's viscosupplementation product for the treatment of osteoarthritis of the knee.
As part of this agreement, Bayer will pay Biomatrix a licensing fee of up to $5 million, including initial and milestone payments.
Biomatrix will manufacture and supply Synvisc to Bayer, which will have exclusive marketing and distribution rights for the countries named in the agreement.
Bayer, with Biomatrix's assistance, will be responsible for obtaining market approval in the various countries.
Biomatrix currently markets Synvisc in Canada and in certain countries of the European Economic Area through distribution agreements and direct sales.
In the United States, Biomatrix has received a recommendation of marketing approval for Synvisc from a U.S. Food and Drug Administration advisory panel.
